  "content": "from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
from astropy.io import fits

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def gong():
    r = []
    for p in sorted((D / "gong").glob("mrzqs*.fits.gz")):
        h = fits.getheader(p)
        r.append(dict(file=p.name, map_time_utc=f"{h['MAPDATE']}T{h['MAPTIME'].strip()}", carrington_rotation=h["CAR_ROT"], cr_lon_at_map_time=h["MAPL0"], crnow=h["CRNOW"], left_edge_lon=h["LONG0"], nfiles=h["NFILETOT"], image_mean_G=h["IMGMN01"]))
    pd.DataFrame(r).to_csv(D / "gong" / "index.csv", index=False)


def adapt():
    r = []
    for p in sorted((D / "adapt").glob("adapt*.fts.gz")):
        h = fits.getheader(p)
        r.append(dict(file=p.name, map_time_utc=h["MAPTIME"], carrington_rotation=int(h["MAPCR"]), map_cr=h["MAPCR"], cr_lon_at_map_time=h["MAPLON"], nreal=h["NREAL"], last_obs_days=h["LAST_OBS"], coverage_pct=h["COVERAGE"], fluxscal=h["FLUXSCAL"], modelver=h["MODELVER"].strip()))
    pd.DataFrame(r).to_csv(D / "adapt" / "index.csv", index=False)


def wsa():
    r = []
    for p in sorted((D / "wsa_ccmc").glob("wsa_*_gong_z.fits")):
        h = fits.getheader(p)
        t = datetime.strptime(h["OBSTIME"], "%Y:%m:%d_%Hh:%Mm:%Ss")
        r.append(dict(file=p.name, ccmc_boundary_name=f"wsadw_gongz_{t:%Y%m%dT%H%M}.fits", map_time_utc=f"{t:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M}", carrington_rotation=h["CARROT"], carrlong_leading_edge=h["CARRLONG"], obscar=h["OBSCAR"], cr_lon_at_map_time=h["OBSLON"], filelist=h["FILELIST"].strip(), radss=h["RADSS"], radout=h["RADOUT"], provers=h["PROVERS"].strip(), mpold_G=h["MPOLD"], realiz=h["REALIZ"]))
    pd.DataFrame(r).to_csv(D / "wsa_ccmc" / "index.csv", index=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    gong()
    adapt()
    wsa()
"

ADAPT Filename Format Notes 
The ADAPT filename format template:
           10         20         30         40
            |          |         |          |
  12345-678901234567-89012345678901-23456789012-3456  [46]
  adapt[ZXABR_CCEFFF]_YYYYMMDDHHNN_[TIIJJKKLLGQ].fts
            |         ------------      |
        Model Tag          |          Last Obs Tag
                           |
                      Map Time Tag
The "model tag" section describes model specific parameters:
            10
             |
    123456789012
    ZXABR_CCEFFF
where:          
    Z - ADAPT file type
          = 4 -> public
    X - LNGTYPE 
          = 0 -> "Carrington Fixed"  // Fixed Carr: 0 to 360
          = 1 -> "Central Meridian"  // Obs/Time CM @ center
    A - input source: 0-all, 1-KPVT, 2-VSM, 3-GONG, 4-HMI, 
                      5-FDT, 7-SVSM_FDT, 8-GONG_FDT, 9- HMI_FDT
    B - data assimilation: 1-enLS 
    R - model spatial resolution -> 1= 1.0 deg, 2= 0.2 deg
   CC - ADAPT code version - major 
    E - ADAPT code version - minor
  FFF - number of model/file realizations, e.g., 12 -> "012"
Plus, the "Last Obs" tag to provide forecast time
last obs time lapse, along with DA information:
            10
             |
    12345678901
    TIIJJKKLLGQ
where:
    T - evolution mode 
          = "a" for a data assimilation step; time values = 0
          = "i" for an intermediate step; time > 0
          = "f" for a forecast step; time > 0
          = "s" for seedmap
   II - days since last assimilated obs (max value is 99)
   JJ - hours since last assimilated obs
   KK - minutes since last assimilated obs
   LL - seconds since last assimilated obs
    G - helioseismic data (added at Map Time) 
          = "n" - not added and/or no data
          = "f" - far-side
          = "e" - emergence
          = "b" - both emergence & far-side
    Q - mag data 
          = "0" - not added and/or no data
          = "1" - mag-los
          = "2" - mag-vector
          = "3" - mag- both los & vector
          = "4" - mag- polar avg obs
          = "5" - mag- los & polar
          = "6" - mag- vector & polar
          = "7" - mag- both los and vector & polar

README for creating synoptic maps:

-- The IDL program displaysynoptic.pro, located in /scr21/jsoc/hmi/synoptic, will take an mdi or hmi magnetogram and create a .ps file that applies a color table (HMI.MagColor.IDL_256.lut) and adds labels. The program is well-commented; take a look inside the program to see how to run it and what it does.

-- The code (displaysynoptic.pro) and colortable (HMI.MagColor.IDL_256.lut) used to generate the maps are in the same directory. Even though the colortable in the directory has 256 colors, the top and bottom bytes are reset to black and white inside of my code. I used the following formula to byte-scale the image:

f(x) = ax + b
a    = 253/3000.
b    = 127.5

By byte-scaling the image in this fashion, the four bins of grey colors are exactly symmetric about zero. As such, we can see the same structure in the weak field as we do in the associated .fits data. 


Monica Bobra
